benchmark_name: Preselected Conjugation-2A 2pl past attestation challenge v14

measured_result.unknown_safety: 8/8 for combined runtime and master exact
measured_result.historical_interpretation: At the first successful untouched post-freeze measurement, buufiseen was unavailable because generic C2A class-level past authorized 3pl only. The scored v14 row therefore measured 0/1 at every required feature dimension while preserving 8/8 unknown safety. caafi remained unresolved and was not scored.

answer_sources.source_family: Ebrahim 2019 Addis Ababa University malaria thesis Somali questionnaire
answer_sources.attested_context: Wali mara kanic sun kaniiceed maku buufiseen?
answer_sources.feature_resolution: The questionnaire directly addresses respondents with the plural/polite 2pl form and uses the completed-event question context; the row is scored as 2pl past. Mood is outside the scored scope.

verification.translation_credit: Omer Said and Berwaqo Ibrahim translated the questionnaires into Af-Somali.

unresolved_targets.reason: No trustworthy exact independent attestation was found during the v14 answer-source search. No surface is inferred from the C2A pattern.

experimental_design.purpose: Test an unsupported C2A 2pl past cell on preselected, long-authorized class lemmas. Score only independently attested surfaces and leave unresolved targets unjudged rather than inferred.

independence_limits.reason: v14 is deliberately narrow. It tests one independently attested preselected 2pl-past surface and preserves caafi as unresolved because no trustworthy exact attestation was found.

notes: PR #38 merged the answer-free target registry before any external lookup. The subsequent search found exact buufiseen in an Addis Ababa University thesis's Somali questionnaire but did not find a trustworthy exact caafi 2pl-past attestation. PR #39 froze that one-row benchmark while runtime still supported class-level 3pl past only. PR #40 then established and locked the untouched 0/1 historical baseline before any 2pl activation.
